title: Boss fight: the client who pays next week

segments.text: Great work, Sam. Payment next week.
label: pov: the client who
pays 'next week'

segments.text: I ran the scenario. Thirty-day terms, or no deal.

caption:
"payment next week" is not a payment date.

Every freelancer has fought this boss. Rent doesn't wait for next week, and neither does your card bill.

What's the longest you've waited on a "next week"? 👇
